name: Warner Mountain Lookout
design: Replica 1920s cupola cab on a 41 ft tower
agency: USDA Forest Service, Willamette National Forest

access.note: Winter rental only; the access road is gated in summer and the lookout is reached by ski, snowshoe, or snowmobile.

visit.trail_note: 2-10 miles by ski, snowshoe, or snowmobile depending on snow depth and route.

rental.season: Early November through mid-May, snow season only
rental.pets: Not stated in the current listing
rules: Reachable only by ski, snowshoe, or snowmobile in winter conditions
No running water or electricity; bring your own water and light
rental.access_note: The access road is gated in summer; winter access is 2-10 miles by ski, snowshoe, or snowmobile only.
rental.description: A 1987 replica of a 1920s cupola cab set on a 41-foot tower on Warner Ridge in the Willamette National Forest. It sleeps up to four and is reserved through recreation.gov for the snow season only.

events.note: Replica cupola cab built on a new 41 ft tower.
Approximate; added to the Forest Service cabin rental program.
